name: str_to_lower
title: Convert string to upper case, lower case, title case, or sentence case

origin.description: Convert each string to lower case.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale for case mapping. Defaults to "en" (English) so the result does not follow the machine locale.

origin.details: The default locale is English. The Turkish locale tr maps I to dotless ı. A missing string stays missing.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.
origin.example:
dog <- "The quick brown dog"
print(str_to_lower(dog))
print(str_to_lower("I", "tr"))

translation.description: Convert each string to lower case. The result is a list. A missing string is stringi._na.NA.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale for case mapping. Defaults to "en" (English) so the result does not follow the machine locale.

translation.details: The default locale is English. The Turkish locale tr maps I to dotless ı. A missing string stays missing. The Python result is a list, and a missing string is stringi._na.NA.
translation.value: A character vector the same length as string.
translation.example:
from stringr.case import str_to_lower
dog = "The quick brown dog"
print(str_to_lower(dog))
print(str_to_lower("I", "tr"))
